blocks.en: Al-haal: ism jaamid
3. When the 'جامد' is used in the meaning of {{condition|mutual participation in engagement}}. Here, the 'جامد' will also be {{ruling|interpreted into a 'مشتق'}}.

blocks.caption: تركيب: أعطيتُ زَيدًا يَدًا بِيَدٍ (9a) و لَقِيْتُ زَيدًا وَجْهًا لِوَجْهٍ (9b)، مع ثَابِتَةً / ثَابِتًا مقدّرا متعلَّقا للجار والمجرور
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb trees for 9a and 9b, with the implied ثَابِتَةً / ثَابِتًا written small as what the jaar-majroor attaches to

blocks.en: I gave (it) to Zaid (whilst) hand in hand.
I met/confronted Zaid (whilst) face to face.

Here as well, the 'جامد' will {{ruling|not correspond}} due to the interpretation of the 'جامد' being intended. In 9a, 'يدًا بِيدٍ' is interpreted as 'مُتَقَابِضَيْنِ' '{{term|اسم الفاعل}}' and in 9b, 'وجهًا لِوجهٍ' is interpreted as 'مُتَقَابِلَيْنِ' 'اسم الفاعل'.
Al-haal: ism jaamid
4. When the 'جامد' is used in its {{condition|original meaning and is not interpreted into a 'مشتق'}}. In this scenario, the 'جامد' {{ruling|must have a 'نعت'}}.

blocks.caption: تركيب: أَنْزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَربِيًّا (10a) و يَخْرُجُ زَيْدٌ رَجلًا كَرِيمًا (10b)

blocks.en: We revealed it (whilst) an Arabic Qur'an.
Zaid is exiting (whilst) a noble man.

Here, the 'جامد' is {{ruling|corresponding with the 'ذو الحال'}} to maintain a valid expression. The meaning of the 'جامد' is intended here. There is {{ruling|no interpretation}} of the 'جامد' into a 'مشتق' here.
Al-haal: ism jaamid
5. When the 'جامد' is considered to be {{condition|a part of the genus of the 'ذو الحال' or vice versa}}. Here as well, the 'جامد' will {{ruling|not be interpreted}} into a 'مشتق'.

blocks.caption: تركيب: إشْتَرَيْتُ الفِضّةَ خَاتِمًا (11a) و إشْتَرَيْتُ الخَاتِمَ فِضَّةً (11b)

blocks.en: I purchased silver in the state of a ring.
I purchased a ring in a silver state.
Here, the 'جامد' will {{ruling|not correspond}} with the 'ذو الحال'. The 'جامد' is not interpreted into a 'مشتق' here.
Al-haal: shibh al-jumlah
The term '{{term|شبه الجملة}}' includes '{{term|جار مجرور}}' and '{{term|ظروف}}' constructions.

blocks.caption: تركيب: رَأَيْتُ الهِرَّةَ عَلى الشَّجَرَةِ (12a) و رَأَيْتُ الهِلَالَ بَيْنَ السَّحَابِ (12b)، مع ثَابِتَةً / ثَابِتًا مقدّرا متعلَّقا
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb trees for 12a and 12b, with the implied ثَابِتَةً / ثَابِتًا written small as the muta'allaq

blocks.en: I saw the cat whilst it was on the tree.
I saw the new moon whilst it was between the clouds.

The 'جار مجرور' and 'ظروف' are '{{ruling|متعلق}}' to '{{ruling|ثابت}}' which {{ruling|correlates to the 'ذو الحال' in number & gender}}. In 12a, 'ثَابِتَةً' is in the feminine form due to 'الهِرَّةَ' being feminine and it's '{{ruling|منصوب}}' because of being 'الحال'. In 12b, 'ثَابِتًا' is in the masculine form due to 'الهِلَالَ' being masculine and it's 'منصوب' because of being 'الحال'.
Al-haal: jumlah fi'liyyah

The 'جملة فعلية' will either begin with a 'ماضي' verb or a 'مضارع' verb. If it begins with a {{condition|'ماضي' verb}}, then a '{{ruling|قَدْ}}', for '{{term|تقريب}}', will be brought before the 'ماضي' verb to express close proximity. Examples of a 'جملة فعلية' 'الحال' beginning with the 'ماضي' verb.

blocks.caption: تركيب: يُصَلِّيْ زَيْدٌ قَدْ تَوَضَّأَ (13a) و أَكَل زَيْدٌ وَ قَدْ وَصَلَ بَكرٌ (13b)
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb trees for 13a and 13b, with the hidden فاعل هو drawn under تَوَضَّأَ

blocks.en: Zaid is praying whilst he had just done wudhu.

labels.label: جملة فعلية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

blocks.ar: أَكَل زَيْدٌ وَ قَدْ وَصَلَ بَكرٌ
blocks.en: Zaid had eaten whilst Bakr had just arrived.

labels.label: جملة فعلية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

labels.word: أَكَل زَيْدٌ وَ قَدْ وَصَلَ بَكرٌ
labels.label: جملة فعلية خبرية

blocks.en: In 13a, 'قَدْ تَوَضَّأَ' is 'الحال'. The 'قَدْ' is expressing {{ruling|proximity}}, suggesting an almost synchronous event. In 13b, 'وَقَدْ وَصَلَ بَكرٌ' is 'الحال'. A 'وَ' is added here known as '{{term|الواو الحالية}}' which will be discussed later.
Al-haal: jumlah fi'liyyah

If the 'جملة فعلية' begins with a {{condition|'مضارع' verb}}, then a 'قَدْ', for 'تقريب', {{ruling|will not be brought}} because the 'مضارع' verb will sync in time with the primary action. Examples of a 'جملة فعلية' 'الحال' beginning with the 'مضارع' verb.

blocks.caption: تركيب: جَاءَ زَيْدٌ يَرْكَبُ (14a) و تَدْرُسُ فاطِمَةُ وَ قَدْ تَجْهَدُ (14b)
blocks.caption_en: Tarkeeb trees for 14a and 14b, with the hidden فاعل هو / هي drawn under the verb

blocks.en: Zaid came whilst riding.

labels.label: جملة فعلية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

blocks.en: Fatimah studies whilst certainly working hard

labels.label: جملة فعلية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

blocks.en: In 14a, 'يَرْكَبُ' is 'الحال'. It is translated as 'رَاكِبًا' and it's able to replace 'يَرْكَبُ'. In 14b, 'وَقَدْ تَجْهَدُ' is 'الحال'. The 'قد' is added for {{ruling|emphasis, not for proximity}}.
Al-haal: jumlah ismiyyah
The 'جملة اسمية' will be {{ruling|any type of a 'جملة اسمية'}}. Whether constructed with a '{{term|مبتدا خبر}}' or '{{term|اسم خبر}}'.

blocks.caption: تركيب: قَامَ زَيْدٌ رِجْلُهُ مَكْسُوْرٌ (15a) و جَاءَ زَيْدٌ وَ الشَّمْسُ طَالَعَةٌ (15b)

blocks.en: Zaid stood whilst his leg was broken.

labels.label: جملة اسمية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

blocks.en: Zaid came whilst the sun was rising.

labels.label: جملة اسمية خبرية - جملة حالية = حال

blocks.en: In 14a, ' رِجْلُهُ مَكْسُوْرٌ' is 'الحال'. There is {{ruling|a pronoun 'ه'}} in reference to the 'ذو الحال'. In 14b, 'وَالشَّمْسُ طَالَعَةٌ' is 'الحال'. There is {{ruling|no pronoun}} in reference to the 'ذو الحال'.
Al-haal: al-waw al-haaliyah
When a 'جملة' is made 'الحال', the 'جملة' is called a '{{term|جملة حالية}}' to signify the purpose and role of the sentence. This does not signify the essence (being اسمية، فعلية) of the sentence.
A 'جملة حالية' {{ruling|requires the presence of a 'رابط' (connector)}} inside of it. This 'رابط' will enable the 'جملة حالية' to remain connected with the primary sentence.

If {{condition|the 'رابط' is not present}} in the 'جملة حالية', it will disconnect and become an independent sentence without any connection to the primary sentence and {{ruling|will NOT express the meaning of 'حال'}}.
A '{{term|ضمير}}', present in the 'جملة حالية', which {{condition|correlates to the 'ذو الحال' in N/G}} will serve as a 'رابط' in this topic.

Sometimes, the 'رابط' is necessary and can not be omitted whilst at other times, it is permissible for the 'رابط' to be omitted. In such scenarios where {{condition|the 'رابط' is omitted from the 'جملة حالية'}}, the '{{ruling|الواو الحالية}}' will substitute the 'رابط'. Therefore, either a 'رابط' will be present in the 'جملة حالية' or 'الواو الحالية' will be present.
However, sometimes {{ruling|both}}, the 'رابط' and the 'الواو الحالية' can be present.
Therefore, it is important to delve further into this matter and acquire additional knowledge to prevent mistakes in our expressions and sentence analysis.
Al-haal: al-waw al-haaliyah
Below are the places where the 'الواو الحالية' {{ruling|MUST be present}}. Whether the 'الواو الحالية' is substituting the 'رابط' or not, it must be present.

blocks.caption: المواضع التي يجب فيها الواو الحالية
